name: Temari (S)
description: Temari (S) has grown over the years. She is now a Jounin as well as the sister of Kankuro and Gaara. Temari is also the Hidden Sand Village's ambassador to the Hidden Leaf Village.

skills.name: Fan Increase Moon
skills.description: Temari opens her fan and reveals a moon. Temari gains 5 points of damage reduction and increases her damage by 5 permanently. This skill stacks and can only be used 3 times. After its third use, it's replaced by 'Fan Interception' permanently.

skills.name: Wind Scythe
skills.description: Using Wind Scythe Temari (S) deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Immense Cutting Whirlwind
skills.description: Temari creates an immense whirlwind in the battlefield, dealing 20 damage to all enemies and lowering their non-affliction damage by 10 for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fan Barrier
skills.description: This skill makes Temari (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fan Interception
skills.description: Temari uses her fan to defend an ally, granting that ally 15 points of damage reduction and making them unable to be killed for 1 turn.
